purpose: Measure error against the known construction axis of retained original threaded reference meshes, after prescribed rigid poses. This is a visible finite digital reference study, not physical or general uncertainty calibration.
truth: The archived original SCAD constructs the nut bore and thread about the Z axis. rotate([0,0,turn_deg]) and axial translation preserve that infinite axis. Apply Ry(tiltY) then Rz(rotateZ) then the supplied translation to both mesh and reference line. This is source-construction reference truth, not an independently measured physical or tessellated feature axis.
decision: Report availability and deviation from that construction line at the fit mean Z, plus angle deviation. Preserve unavailable fits. Do not establish a pass threshold, calibrated bound or assembly verdict. Record actual Float32 rewrite rounding separately from estimator error.
